      <label>Place of Death (বাংলা)</label>
      <input type="text" id="cf-place-bn" value="বগুড়া, বাংলাদেশ" oninput="cfUpdate()">
    </div>
    <div class="cf-row">
      <label>Place of Death (English)</label>
      <input type="text" id="cf-place-en" value="Bogura, Bangladesh" oninput="cfUpdate()">
    </div>
    <div class="cf-row">
      <label>Cause of Death (English)</label>
      <input type="text" id="cf-cause-en" value="Natural Death" oninput="cfUpdate()">
    </div>
    <div class="cf-row">
      <label>Cause of Death (বাংলা, কোলন ছাড়া)</label>
      <input type="text" id="cf-cause-bn" value="স্বাভাবিক অবস্থায় মরণ" oninput="cfUpdate()">
    </div>

    <button id="cf-print-btn" onclick="window.print()">Print করুন</button>
  </div>
</div>

<script>

// ---- Date to words converter ----
var ones = ['','One','Two','Three','Four','Five','Six','Seven','Eight','Nine',
  'Ten','Eleven','Twelve','Thirteen','Fourteen','Fifteen','Sixteen',
  'Seventeen','Eighteen','Nineteen'];
var tens = ['','','Twenty','Thirty','Forty','Fifty','Sixty','Seventy','Eighty','Ninety'];
var months = ['','January','February','March','April','May','June',
  'July','August','September','October','November','December'];
var ordinals = ['','First','Second','Third','Fourth','Fifth','Sixth','Seventh',
  'Eighth','Ninth','Tenth','Eleventh','Twelfth','Thirteenth','Fourteenth',
  'Fifteenth','Sixteenth','Seventeenth','Eighteenth','Nineteenth','Twentieth',
  'Twenty First','Twenty Second','Twenty Third','Twenty Fourth','Twenty Fifth',
  'Twenty Sixth','Twenty Seventh','Twenty Eighth','Twenty Ninth','Thirtieth',
  'Thirty First'];

function numToWords(n) {
  if (n === 0) return 'Zero';
  if (n < 20) return ones[n];
  if (n < 100) return tens[Math.floor(n/10)] + (n%10 ? ' ' + ones[n%10] : '');
  if (n < 1000) return ones[Math.floor(n/100)] + ' Hundred' + (n%100 ? ' ' + numToWords(n%100) : '');
  if (n < 10000) return ones[Math.floor(n/1000)] + ' Thousand' + (n%1000 ? ' ' + numToWords(n%1000) : '');
  return n.toString();
}

function dateToWords(dateStr) {
  // expects dd/mm/yyyy
  var parts = dateStr.split('/');
  if (parts.length !== 3) return '';
  var d = parseInt(parts[0]), m = parseInt(parts[1]), y = parseInt(parts[2]);
  if (!d || !m || !y || m > 12 || d > 31) return '';
  var dayWord = ordinals[d] || '';
  var monthWord = months[m] || '';
  var yearWord = numToWords(y);
  if (!dayWord || !monthWord || !yearWord) return '';
  return dayWord + ' of ' + monthWord + ' ' + yearWord;
}

function cfDodChange(val) {
  var words = dateToWords(val);
  if (words) {
    var wordEl = document.getElementById('cf-dod-word');
    if (wordEl) wordEl.value = words;
  }
  cfUpdate();
}

// ---- Auto-update cert fields ----
function cfUpdate() {
  var simple = {
    'cf-reg-num':       'd-reg-num',
    'cf-date-reg':      'd-date-reg',
    'cf-date-issue':    'd-date-issue',
    'cf-name-bn':       'd-name-bn',
    'cf-name-en':       'd-name-en',
    'cf-sex':           'd-sex',
    'cf-dob':           'd-dob',
    'cf-mother-bn':     'd-mother-bn',
    'cf-mother-en':     'd-mother-en',
    'cf-mother-nat-bn': 'd-mother-nat-bn',
    'cf-father-bn':     'd-father-bn',
    'cf-father-en':     'd-father-en',
    'cf-father-nat-bn': 'd-father-nat-bn',
    'cf-father-nat-en': 'd-father-nat-en',
    'cf-dod':           'd-dod',
    'cf-dod-word':      'd-dod-word',
    'cf-place-bn':      'd-place-bn',
    'cf-place-en':      'd-place-en',
    'cf-cause-en':      'd-cause-en',
  };
  for (var fid in simple) {
    var inp = document.getElementById(fid);
    var tgt = document.getElementById(simple[fid]);
    if (inp && tgt) tgt.textContent = inp.value;
  }
  // cause-bn: colon prefix
  var cb = document.getElementById('cf-cause-bn');
  var cbt = document.getElementById('d-cause-bn');
  if (cb && cbt) cbt.innerHTML = ': ' + cb.value;
  // mother-nat-en: append Nationality
  var mn = document.getElementById('cf-mother-nat-en');
  var mnt = document.getElementById('d-mother-nat-en');
  if (mn && mnt) mnt.textContent = mn.value + '\u00a0Nationality';
}

// ---- Font size controls ----
var fsSizes = {
  'name-bn': 14, 'name-en': 14,
  'mother-bn': 14, 'mother-en': 14,
  'father-bn': 14, 'father-en': 14
};
function cfFsApply(key) {
  var sz = fsSizes[key];
  var el = document.getElementById('d-' + key);
  if (el) el.style.fontSize = sz + 'px';
  var slider = document.getElementById('fs-' + key);
  if (slider) slider.value = sz;
  var lbl = document.getElementById('fsv-' + key);
  if (lbl) lbl.textContent = sz + 'px';
}
function cfFsChange(key, delta) {
  fsSizes[key] = Math.min(24, Math.max(8, fsSizes[key] + delta));
  cfFsApply(key);
}
function cfFsSlider(key, val) {
  fsSizes[key] = parseInt(val);
  cfFsApply(key);
}


// ---- Bulk paste parser ----
function cfBulkParse(text) {
  if (!text.trim()) return;
  var lines = text.split('\n').map(function(l){ return l.trim(); });
  var data = {};
  for (var i = 0; i < lines.length - 1; i++) {
    var key = lines[i];
    var val = lines[i+1];
    // skip if val looks like another label (ends with common label patterns)
    data[key] = val;
  }

  var filled = 0;

  function set(inputId, val) {
    var el = document.getElementById(inputId);
    if (el && val) { el.value = val; filled++; }
  }

  // Mapping BDRIS labels to form fields
  set('cf-reg-num',     data['মৃত্যু নিবন্ধন নম্বর']);
  set('cf-dob',         data['জন্ম তারিখ']);
  var dodVal = data['মৃত্যুর তারিখ'];
  if (dodVal) { set('cf-dod', dodVal); cfDodChange(dodVal); }
  set('cf-date-reg',    data['নিবন্ধনের তারিখ']);
  set('cf-date-issue',  data['নিবন্ধনের তারিখ']); // same date
  set('cf-cause-bn',    data['মৃত্যুর কারণ']);
  set('cf-name-bn',     data['পুরো নাম']);
  set('cf-name-en',     data['পুরো নাম ইংরেজিতে']);
  set('cf-mother-bn',   data['মাতার নাম']);
  set('cf-mother-en',   data['মাতার নাম ইংরেজিতে']);
  set('cf-mother-nat-bn', data['মাতার জাতীয়তা']);
  set('cf-father-bn',   data['পিতার নাম']);
  set('cf-father-nat-bn', data['পিতার জাতীয়তা']);
  set('cf-place-bn',     data['মৃত্যুর স্থান']);
  set('cf-place-en',     data['মৃত্যুর স্থান ইংরেজিতে']);
  set('cf-cause-en',     data['মৃত্যুর কারণ ইংরেজিতে']);
  set('cf-mother-nat-en', data['মাতার জাতীয়তা ইংরেজিতে']);
  set('cf-father-nat-en', data['পিতার জাতীয়তা ইংরেজিতে']);

  // Sex
  var sex = data['লিঙ্গ'];
  if (sex) {
    var sel = document.getElementById('cf-sex');
    if (sel) {
      if (sex.toUpperCase().indexOf('MALE') !== -1 && sex.toUpperCase().indexOf('FE') === -1) {
        sel.value = 'Sex : Male';
      } else {
        sel.value = 'Sex : Female';
      }
      filled++;
    }
  }

  // Father English — not always in BDRIS text, derive from Bengali if not present
  var fatherEn = data['পিতার নাম ইংরেজিতে'];
  if (fatherEn) set('cf-father-en', fatherEn);

  // Mother nationality English default
  var mnatBn = data['মাতার জাতীয়তা'];
  if (mnatBn && mnatBn.indexOf('বাংলা') !== -1) {
    var el = document.getElementById('cf-mother-nat-en');
    if (el) { el.value = 'Bangladeshi'; filled++; }
  }
  var fnatBn = data['পিতার জাতীয়তা'];
  if (fnatBn && fnatBn.indexOf('বাংলা') !== -1) {
    var el2 = document.getElementById('cf-father-nat-en');
    if (el2) { el2.value = 'Bangladeshi'; filled++; }
    var el3 = document.getElementById('cf-father-nat-bn');
    if (el3 && !el3.value) { el3.value = fnatBn; filled++; }
  }

  // Now apply to cert
  cfUpdate();

  // Show status
  if (filled > 0) {
    document.getElementById('cf-bulk-status').style.display = 'block';
    document.getElementById('cf-bulk-msg').textContent = filled + 'টি ফিল্ড অটো ফিল হয়েছে!';
  }
}

// ---- Panel show/hide/minimize/maximize ----
function cfHide() {
  document.getElementById('cert-form-panel').style.display = 'none';
  document.getElementById('cf-toggle-btn').style.display = 'block';
}
function cfShow() {
  document.getElementById('cert-form-panel').style.display = 'flex';
  document.getElementById('cf-toggle-btn').style.display = 'none';
}
function cfMinimize() {
  document.getElementById('cert-form-panel').classList.add('minimized');
  document.getElementById('cf-min-btn').style.display = 'none';
  document.getElementById('cf-max-btn').style.display = 'inline';
}
function cfMaximize() {
  document.getElementById('cert-form-panel').classList.remove('minimized');
  document.getElementById('cf-min-btn').style.display = 'inline';
  document.getElementById('cf-max-btn').style.display = 'none';
}
cfUpdate();
